title: Remove the unused reader includeWww option from the app-shell template
description: Papyrus PR #140 added reader.includeWww (site-config.ts validation, addReaderApp subDomainSettings, examples/pilobol-us.site.json, README, docs/site-hosting.md, docs/standard-site.md, scripts/test-infra-site-config.ts, scripts/test-infra-synth.mjs). Decision 2026-10-06: the new Pilobol.us does not support www and nothing uses the option. Remove it (YAGNI, no compat shim). Reader domains revert to apex-only: one subDomainSetting with prefix "". Unknown key in site.json fails validation like other unknown keys. Code only, no AWS.
right_now_summary: Remove the unused reader.includeWww option and restore apex-only reader domains.
